## Summary and final contract

Implements per-request speculative-decoding opt-out for EAGLE, EAGLE3, and STANDALONE, including mixed batches. Related RFC: #47797.

`SamplingParams.disable_speculative_decoding=True` means **one target-root token committed per decode iteration**. The opted-out row independently uses the ordinary target sampler; draft proposals are not accepted. Draft prefill, proposal, and extend work **continues**, including when every row opts out, to preserve the configured execution layout and draft KV state.

This is deliberately narrower than the RFC's zero-draft-work request. It is not a target-only performance baseline or a promise of bitwise-identical sequences across separately configured servers. Maintainer agreement on this contract remains necessary.

## Changes

- Propagate opt-out masks and host flags through batch construction, filtering, merging, and empty batches.
- Sample and replace the target-root token, then truncate acceptance counts and index sentinels. Clamping acceptance length alone would not ensure the correct target-root output.
- Preserve draft extend inputs, retained-token/bonus-token bookkeeping, and runtime shapes for mixed and all-opt-out batches.
- Reject opt-out batches from post-verify graph replay; model forward CUDA graphs remain supported. Exclude deliberate zero draft acceptance from adaptive accuracy feedback.
- Reject unsupported algorithms and custom logit processors. Carry the field through the native API schema, protobuf, and generated Python/Rust bindings.
- Add regression tests, CUDA graph checks, model lifecycle diagnostics, and reproducible environment/resume scripts.

### Separate EAGLE3 output-head fix

[`b751b5f3`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/commit/b751b5f3816a43603e85591850e6c70b003f611b) is a **separate commit fixing an existing EAGLE3 reduced-vocabulary head-loading bug**, not the opt-out contract itself. An enabled-only control reproduced the failure.

When a draft checkpoint has a reduced vocabulary and `tie_word_embeddings=True`, its trained `lm_head` must remain separate from target embeddings. The fix preserves that head during checkpoint loading and target-embedding sharing; equal-vocabulary tying is retained. The focused regression failed before the fix (1 failed, 1 passed) and passes after it (2 passed). Reviewers can evaluate or split this commit independently.

## Validation

| Scope | Observed result |
| --- | --- |
| Local focused suites after the head fix | **29 passed, 2 skipped, 25 subtests**. Skips require CUDA/native seeded kernels. |
| H100 GPU unit suites at `510d3f19` | **41 passed, 191 subtests, no skips**: head loading, opt-out sampling, diagnostics, post-verify graphs, and native API contract. No empty-graph warning in this unit run. |
| EAGLE3 model E2E, eager and CUDA graph modes | **Both passed**. Each run observed 38 actual mixed verify rounds, 659 direct draft-state probes, and 606 KV page checks. The graph run observed 560 target-verify forward-graph rounds containing opted-out requests. |
| Lifecycle and reuse, both modes | Mixed → all-opt-out → mixed; normal streaming, natural EOS, explicit cancellation, and stream disconnect. After each release case, later requests reused both request rows and overlapping physical KV slots successfully. |

Model tests used Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B + AngelSlim/Qwen3-1.7B_eagle3, H100, BF16, TP=1, Triton, page size 16, top-k=1, draft width 4, three speculative steps, and overlap scheduling. Opted-out rows accepted exactly one token in all 591 observations per run; enabled rows accepted 1–4 tokens. The 80-token comparison matched isolated/mixed execution, normal streaming, and two post-release reruns. Streaming prefixes were monotonic.

Direct draft-state probes checked the full committed prefix in every draft layer for immutable K/V values and stable mappings, finite newly committed slots, no within-request slot aliasing, sequence-length increments, retained draft-extend inputs, and bonus-token consistency. **These are not independent fresh-recomputation equality checks of newly committed K/V.**

**Post-upstream-merge GPU regression passed at clean head `2ecbb7b8` on 2026-11-03.** One H200 SXM ran the same pinned image/model pair after H100/A100 capacity was unavailable. GPU units: **41 passed, 191 subtests, no skips**. Both eager and graph EAGLE3 lifecycle runs passed, each with **38 mixed rounds, 659 draft-state probes, and 606 KV page checks**; the graph run observed 560 target-verify graph rounds. Isolated/mixed output, streaming, EOS, cancellation, disconnect, and subsequent request-row/physical-slot reuse checks passed. The single graph-warmup empty-graph warning remains as documented below. No runtime fix was needed. Latest head `5931ed0c` only adds the [post-merge evidence report](https://github.com/anencore94/sglang/blob/5931ed0c6ff145e444255eb0a6dd9f542e482467/test/manual/spec/per_request_spec_opt_out_eagle3_results.txt). Full evidence was downloaded and hash-verified before stopping the Pod; compute/storage are off. Earlier local post-merge checks: **90 passed, 5 skipped, 71 subtests**; direct unittest: 10 passed, 2 skipped; corrected-file pre-commit passed.

## Numerical diagnosis and remaining limits

- Earlier STANDALONE target-only comparisons had **14 exact token-sequence mismatches**; those assertions remain recorded as failures. Same-prefix diagnostics at the two first-divergence sites found BF16 root-logit ties and correct lower-ID argmax/token-logprob agreement. FP16 removed those ties and matched the tested outputs. This supports numerical sensitivity at those sites, not a blanket proof of identical logits or KV across all execution modes.
- One empty CUDA graph warning remains in the model graph-mode warmup, consistent with the separate no-op Mamba-state commit capture for the dense Qwen3 model. It did not indicate an empty target forward/sampling graph; lifecycle checks passed. Unit graph-warning coverage and this model-warmup observation are distinct.
- TP/PP/DP combinations, HiSparse, top-k > 1, broader models/transports, and throughput/latency benchmarks remain unvalidated. Diagnostic probes synchronize execution and are not performance measurements.
- The existing EAGLE-family `return_sampling_mask` limitation remains; ordinary streaming is covered.
- Local/GPU results above are independent evidence, **not upstream CI success**. The pre-transition Base CI run was blocked by the draft gate; repository CI also requires the appropriate `run-ci` authorization. Latest-head CI must be green and maintainer review completed before merge.

## Evidence and reproduction

- [EAGLE3 results, pinned environment, head-fix control, KV/lifecycle observations](https://github.com/anencore94/sglang/blob/11b18bfe5583a3d185f8c1578588e9cc7883ef36/test/manual/spec/per_request_spec_opt_out_eagle3_results.txt)
- [EAGLE3 lifecycle harness](https://github.com/anencore94/sglang/blob/11b18bfe5583a3d185f8c1578588e9cc7883ef36/test/manual/spec/test_eagle3_opt_out_lifecycle.py)
- [Same-prefix numerical diagnosis](https://github.com/anencore94/sglang/blob/11b18bfe5583a3d185f8c1578588e9cc7883ef36/test/manual/spec/per_request_spec_opt_out_prefix_results.txt)
- [Environment preparation script](https://github.com/anencore94/sglang/blob/11b18bfe5583a3d185f8c1578588e9cc7883ef36/test/manual/spec/prepare_per_request_spec_opt_out_e2e.sh)
- [Resume procedure and commands](https://github.com/anencore94/sglang/blob/11b18bfe5583a3d185f8c1578588e9cc7883ef36/test/manual/spec/per_request_spec_opt_out_e2e_resume.txt)

+## Per-request one-token acceptance
+
+On servers using `EAGLE`, `EAGLE3`, or `STANDALONE`, you can set
+`sampling_params.disable_speculative_decoding` to `true` on a `/generate` request.
+The default is `false`. The flag limits that request to one newly sampled target
+root token per decode iteration, including when it shares a batch with requests
+that accept several tokens. The root uses the ordinary target sampler, including
+its temperature, top-k/top-p/min-p, and per-request seed policy.
+
+Despite the parameter name, **draft-model work still runs**. Draft prefill,
+proposal generation, and draft extend keep their configured widths and KV state,
+even when every request in the batch opts out. The flag does not provide a
+no-draft-work latency or throughput baseline. Post-verify graph replay falls back
+to eager execution for batches containing opted-out requests; the other eligible
+model-forward graphs remain available.
+
+Other speculative algorithms reject this flag rather than silently ignoring it.
+Opted-out speculative requests currently reject custom logit processors, and
+EAGLE-family requests still do not support `return_sampling_mask`. Ordinary token
+streaming and logprobs use the single committed token. When speculation is disabled
+server-wide, the flag has no effect.
+
+Matching the ordinary sampling policy does not guarantee bitwise-identical output
+between a speculative server and a separate non-speculative server: attention
+kernels, batching, and floating-point logits can differ. Unseeded sampling also
+consumes a different random stream. Use identical root logits and per-request
+seeds when testing sampler equivalence; validate model-level equivalence separately
+on the deployment hardware.
+

+"""Offline analysis of diagnose_spec_opt_out_prefix.py artifacts.
+
+No tolerance converts a token mismatch into a pass. Full-prefix checks gate
+score comparisons; matching only the last input token is insufficient.
+"""
+
+import json
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+
+
+def score_summary(values, selected, reference):
+    values, reference = np.asarray(values), np.asarray(reference)
+    if values.ndim != 1 or values.shape != reference.shape or values.size < 2:
+        raise ValueError("expected equal vocabulary vectors")
+    if not np.isfinite(values).all() or not np.isfinite(reference).all():
+        raise ValueError("non-finite logits")
+    winners = np.flatnonzero(values == values.max()).tolist()
+    top = np.partition(values, -2)[-2:]
+    delta = values.astype(np.float64) - reference
+    return dict(
+        selected=selected,
+        greedy_argmax_correct=selected == winners[0],
+        tied_max_ids=winners,
+        top_margin=float(top.max() - top.min()),
+        max_abs_delta_from_fresh=float(np.abs(delta).max()),
+        rms_delta_from_fresh=float(np.sqrt(np.mean(delta**2))),
+    )
+
+
+def same_prefix(request_ids, emitted_ids, prefix):
+    history = list(request_ids) + list(emitted_ids)
+    return len(history) >= len(prefix) and history[: len(prefix)] == prefix
+
+
+def analyze(root):
+    root = Path(root)
+    inputs = json.loads((root / "inputs.json").read_text())
+    prefixes = {int(k): v for k, v in inputs["prefixes"].items()}
+    records = [
+        json.loads(s) for s in (root / "captures.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()
+    ]
+    responses = {}
+    for mode in ("target", "spec"):
+        for case in (
+            "warm_plain",
+            "warm_probe",
+            "fresh-0",
+            "fresh-1",
+            "one-decode-0",
+            "one-decode-1",
+        ):
+            saved = json.loads((root / f"{mode}-{case}.json").read_text())
+            rows = json.loads(saved["response_text"])
+            for row in rows:
+                assert row["output_ids"] == [
+                    x[1] for x in row["meta_info"]["output_token_logprobs"]
+                ]
+            responses[f"{mode}-{case}"] = (
+                saved["request"]["input_ids"],
+                [r["output_ids"] for r in rows],
+            )
+    summary = []
+    for record in records:
+        name = record["name"]
+        case = next(k for k in responses if name.startswith(k + "-"))
+        index, prefix = next(
+            (i, p) for i, p in prefixes.items() if len(p) - 1 == record["position"]

+        row = index if "warm_" in case else 0

+

+KV checks. This is a correctness test, not a performance benchmark. Dense
+STANDALONE coverage does not establish EAGLE3, HiSparse, or distributed behavior.
+"""

+def response_token_ids(row, expected_length):
+    """Check the emitted IDs independently of the logprob metadata being tested."""
+    ids = row["output_ids"]
+    logprob_ids = [item[1] for item in row["meta_info"]["output_token_logprobs"]]
+    assert ids == logprob_ids, "Emitted output_ids disagree with logprob token IDs"
+    assert len(ids) == expected_length, (len(ids), expected_length)
+    return ids
+
+
+def token_mismatch(actual, expected, *, mode, row, wave):
+    if actual == expected:
+        return None
+    first = next(
+        (i for i, (a, b) in enumerate(zip(actual, expected)) if a != b),
+        min(len(actual), len(expected)),
+    )
+    return dict(
+        mode=mode,
+        row=row,
+        wave=wave,
+        first_difference=first,
+        actual=actual,
+        expected=expected,
+    )
+
+
+def install_probes():
+    # Executed at module scope in the server bootstrap, including spawned ranks.
